rationale: The assistant correctly explained 'SA2' as the model series, ran a sensible simple-first clock/manual check, then had the customer isolate power and test the fan blade by hand, arriving at the right diagnosis (seized fan motor bearings). Safety handling was sound, though the stop-use card on a one-off 'slight hot smell' was somewhat heavy-handed, and 'confirm' is a touch over-confident. Weaknesses: it never asked for the full model from the rating plate, nor the customer's comfort with a power-off motor swap (ground truth says this is competent DIY), defaulting straight to an engineer with 'fit the new part' unspecified.
